hunks.baseline: So Gyo watched Jin Taekyung’s back until it vanished in the distance, turning over the faint words she’d heard moments ago, carried to her on the wind.
hunks.sol: So Gyo watched Jin Taekyung until he vanished in the distance, turning over the faint words the wind had carried to her moments ago.

hunks.baseline: *“He’s still a kid, you crazy bastards.”*
hunks.sol: *He’s still a kid, you crazy bastards.*

hunks.baseline: So Gyo suddenly wondered what expression Jin Taekyung had worn when he said it. How much sincerity had been in the back of him as he left, with anger and bitterness hanging over him?
hunks.sol: She wondered what expression he’d worn when he said them. How much of the anger and bitterness she’d sensed as he walked away had been genuine?

hunks.baseline: But there was no way for her to know.
hunks.sol: There was no way for her to know.

hunks.baseline: As So Gyo repeated the saying to herself, Baek Yeon abruptly spoke.
hunks.sol: As So Gyo repeated the saying to herself, Baek Yeon spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Jin Taekyung coming here. Was that what you intended?”
hunks.sol: “Did you intend for Jin Taekyung to come here?”

hunks.baseline: “Not particularly. What happened just now was only a coincidence.”
hunks.sol: “Not particularly. What happened just now was a coincidence.”

hunks.baseline: “A coincidence. Then the reason you asked His Majesty to let him move about freely…”
hunks.sol: “A coincidence. Then why did you ask His Majesty to let him move about freely?”

hunks.baseline: “I needed to keep a closer eye on him. You already know some of the reasons I’ve been staying in the imperial palace, don’t you?”
hunks.sol: “I needed to watch him more closely. You already know some of the reasons I’ve been staying in the imperial palace, don’t you?”

hunks.baseline: So Gyo answered Baek Yeon, whose eyes had suddenly widened, in an even voice.
hunks.sol: Baek Yeon’s eyes widened. So Gyo answered in an even voice.

hunks.baseline: “I can’t be certain yet…but I think he’s the one. The person I’ve been looking for. And the person that person foretold.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t be certain yet…but I think he’s the one. The person I’ve been looking for. The person that person foretold.”

hunks.baseline: There was not a trace of formality in the words the beautiful woman in her thirties spoke to the half-white-haired veteran, but Baek Yeon paid it no mind.
hunks.sol: The beautiful woman in her thirties spoke to the graying veteran without the slightest formality, but Baek Yeon paid it no mind.

hunks.baseline: The woman calling herself So Gyo had the standing and the strength to speak that way. And her answer just now was more astonishing than he’d expected.
hunks.sol: The woman calling herself So Gyo had the standing and the strength to speak that way. Besides, her answer was more astonishing than he’d expected.

hunks.baseline: “So that’s why you made him stay in the imperial palace?”
hunks.sol: “So that’s why you had him stay in the imperial palace?”

hunks.baseline: “I had to see for myself. Whether the rumors surrounding the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung, were true. Whether he really was the one that person spoke of. And…”
hunks.sol: “I had to see for myself whether the rumors about the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung, were true. Whether he really was the one that person spoke of. And…”

hunks.baseline: So Gyo turned her head. Her gaze swept over the place where someone had been moments ago, though that person was already gone. For an instant, her eyes gleamed sharply.
hunks.sol: So Gyo turned her head. Her gaze swept over the place where Jin Taekyung had stood. For an instant, her eyes sharpened.

hunks.baseline: Fortunately, the outcome of this chance encounter had been excellent. Perhaps not for Jin Taekyung, who had left with anger in his heart, but So Gyo had gained a measure of certainty and sorted out her thoughts.
hunks.sol: The chance encounter had turned out well. Perhaps not for Jin Taekyung, who had left in anger, but So Gyo had seen enough to sort out her thoughts and gain a measure of certainty.

hunks.baseline: So Gyo placed the names of the two rising martial artists she had been watching for some time on the scales in her mind.
hunks.sol: She placed the names of the two rising martial artists she’d been watching on the scales in her mind. Unlike when she’d first learned of them, the scales now tipped toward one.

hunks.baseline: And unlike when she’d first heard of them, she could see the scales tipping toward one of them.
As she’d told Baek Yeon, it was too soon to be certain. But given Jin Taekyung’s past actions and what she’d seen and sensed herself, there was every chance he was the person she was looking for.
hunks.sol: As she’d told Baek Yeon, it was too soon to be certain. But given Jin Taekyung’s past actions and what she’d seen and sensed herself, there was a good chance he was the person she sought.

hunks.baseline: Thinking this to herself, So Gyo slowly crossed the flower garden.
hunks.sol: So Gyo slowly crossed the flower garden.

hunks.baseline: The place had been left in shambles by their brief clash, as if a storm had swept through it. At its center, something hidden beneath the flowers and grass poked up through the dirt.
hunks.sol: Their brief clash had left it looking as though a storm had swept through. At its center, something that had been hidden beneath the flowers and grass poked up through the dirt.

hunks.baseline: How deep beneath the ground had it been buried, and for how long?
hunks.sol: How deep had it been buried? How long had it lain there?

hunks.baseline: So Gyo greeted the familiar-looking object as if speaking to herself, then reached out.
hunks.sol: So Gyo greeted the familiar object as if speaking to herself, then reached out.

hunks.baseline: Whoooom—THUNK!
hunks.sol: Whoooom—thunk!

hunks.baseline: As an enormous, unseen surge of qi shook the air, two objects buried deep in the ground shot up into So Gyo’s hands.
hunks.sol: An enormous, unseen surge of qi shook the air. Two objects buried deep in the ground shot up into So Gyo’s hands.

hunks.baseline: They were exactly alike in length and width, as if measured with a ruler. Each also curved gently toward its tip.
hunks.sol: They were identical in length and width, as if measured with a ruler. Each curved gently toward its tip, much like a saber.

hunks.baseline: They looked much like curved sabers. So Gyo hung one at each hip, then spoke to Baek Yeon, who had been watching her.
hunks.sol: So Gyo hung one at each hip, then spoke to Baek Yeon, who was watching her.

hunks.baseline: “To the point of staking your life?”
hunks.sol: “Enough to stake your life on it?”

hunks.baseline: Baek Yeon followed the question with a calm reply.
hunks.sol: His expression remained calm as he went on.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve always staked my life to get what I wanted. That’s how I made it this far.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve always staked my life on getting what I wanted. That’s how I made it this far.”

hunks.baseline: Baek Yeon’s eyes sank as heavily as his voice.
hunks.sol: Baek Yeon’s eyes grew as grave as his voice.

hunks.baseline: “Anything, within what I can answer.”
hunks.sol: “Anything, if it’s something I can answer.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course I have. But before we wipe them all out in one place, we should go after Jin Taekyung right now—”
hunks.sol: “Of course I have. But rather than wait to wipe them all out in one place, we could deal with Jin Taekyung now—”

hunks.baseline: “Impossible.”
hunks.sol: “No.”

hunks.baseline: So Gyo cut Baek Yeon off firmly, then spoke.
hunks.sol: So Gyo cut him off firmly.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “There are still things we need to confirm. Until then, it’s better to let things proceed as they are.”
hunks.sol: “There’s still more I need to confirm. Until then, it’s better to let things proceed as they are.”

hunks.baseline: “An obstacle. For example?”
hunks.sol: “An obstacle? How?”

hunks.baseline: “As you know, Jin Taekyung’s master is the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang. And, by coincidence, he vanished without a trace after reaching the imperial capital. The other Murim martial artists following Jin Taekyung won’t make much difference to the larger situation, but…if they draw the Fire King in as well, things could become complicated.”
hunks.sol: “As you know, Jin Taekyung’s master is the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang. And, as it happens, he vanished without a trace after reaching the Imperial Capital. The other Murim martial artists following Jin Taekyung won’t make much difference, but…if they draw the Fire King in as well, things could become complicated.”

hunks.baseline: Though the government and Murim were meant to stay out of each other’s affairs, there wasn’t a soul in the land who hadn’t heard of the man’s fame after more than a hundred years of life.
hunks.sol: The government and Murim might be meant to stay out of each other’s affairs, but after more than a hundred years, there was no one in the land who hadn’t heard of him.

hunks.baseline: And Baek Yeon, who had led the Embroidered Uniform Guard since the late Emperor’s reign, was among those who knew better than anyone whether the countless rumors surrounding the Fire King were true.
hunks.sol: And Baek Yeon, who had led the Embroidered Uniform Guard since the late Emperor’s reign, knew better than most which of the countless rumors about the Fire King were true.

hunks.baseline: A martial prowess that towered above even those powerful enough to be called kings.
hunks.sol: A man whose martial prowess towered above even those powerful enough to be called kings.

hunks.baseline: He could not reach someone born in a human body and called a god, but he stood shoulder to shoulder with the Three Stars. If he took the other side, they would have to be prepared for tremendous losses.
hunks.sol: He could not reach the one born human who had come to be called a god, but he was said to stand shoulder to shoulder with the Three Stars. If he took the other side, they would have to be prepared for tremendous losses.

hunks.baseline: Even with So Gyo, himself, the Emperor, and several other Supreme Peak masters on their side.
hunks.sol: Even with So Gyo, Baek Yeon himself, the Emperor, and several other Supreme Peak masters on their side.

hunks.baseline: “Their forces are already formidable enough. And that’s only what we’ve managed to learn so far. If the Fire King joins them after Jin Taekyung…”
hunks.sol: “Their forces are already formidable. And that’s only what we’ve managed to learn so far. If the Fire King joins them after Jin Taekyung…”

hunks.baseline: Then, seeing So Gyo continue with a faint smile on her lips, he realized she’d meant what she said.
hunks.sol: Then So Gyo continued, a faint smile on her lips, and he realized she meant it.

hunks.baseline: “No, actually, that might be better.”
hunks.sol: “No. That might be even better.”

hunks.baseline: Leaving Baek Yeon frozen like a statue, unable to understand her at all, So Gyo turned away with a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: Baek Yeon stood frozen like a statue, unable to make sense of her words. So Gyo gave a quiet laugh and turned away, keeping the rest to herself.

hunks.baseline: The words she hadn’t told him drifted through her mind.
The story So Gyo had kept from him was something only she and the Emperor knew. Secrets were better off unknown.
hunks.sol: What she hadn’t told him was known only to her and the Emperor. A secret was better kept secret.

hunks.baseline: At least until the banquet that both allies and enemies were eagerly awaiting.
hunks.sol: At least until the banquet both allies and enemies were so eagerly awaiting.

hunks.baseline: So Gyo looked up at the sky, now dark with night, and murmured. As if sensing the calm before the storm that had already begun, cold raindrops started to fall.
hunks.sol: So Gyo looked up at the sky, now dark, and murmured. Cold raindrops began to fall, as if confirming her sense that the calm before the storm was already upon them.

hunks.baseline: The heavy rain hammered everything around us.
hunks.sol: Heavy rain hammered everything around us.

hunks.baseline: It was so loud that it swallowed even the shouts of the palace attendants running here and there in bamboo rain hats and rain cloaks.
hunks.sol: It swallowed even the shouts of palace attendants running here and there in woven bamboo hats and rain cloaks.

hunks.baseline: Even after spending a good while in Murim, this was the fiercest downpour I’d ever experienced. The unexpected rain and thunder were more than enough to block the watchers’ view.
hunks.sol: I’d spent a good while in Murim, but I’d never seen a downpour like this. The unexpected rain and thunder were more than enough to obscure the watchers’ view.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin asked, his face tense. I answered,
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s face was tense.

hunks.baseline: “What if they catch you…”
hunks.sol: “What if they catch you…?”

hunks.baseline: “They won’t. Not in this situation. You were there and heard it too, so you know.”
hunks.sol: “They won’t. Not in this situation. You heard what I did.”

hunks.baseline: “I do. I know it’s urgent. But even so…”
hunks.sol: “I know. I know it’s urgent. But still…”

hunks.baseline: “It’ll be all right. If it’s Young Master Jin.”
hunks.sol: “It’ll be all right if it’s Young Master Jin.”

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin suddenly spoke, his voice subdued.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin spoke up, his voice subdued.

hunks.baseline: “Even if they catch him, there’s a good chance they’ll pretend they didn’t see him.”
hunks.sol: “Even if they spot him, there’s a good chance they’ll pretend they didn’t.”

hunks.baseline: “If what Young Master Jin told us is true, what they want is to wipe us all out at once. They intend to uproot us in one fell swoop. We have no choice.”
hunks.sol: “If what Young Master Jin told us is true, they want to wipe us all out at once. They intend to uproot us in one fell swoop…and that leaves us no choice.”

hunks.baseline: Would So Gyo and Baek Yeon have let me go without a thought?
hunks.sol: Would So Gyo and Baek Yeon have let me go without thinking it through?

hunks.baseline: Even knowing full well that this story would reach their enemies?
hunks.sol: Even knowing full well I’d tell their enemies what had happened?

hunks.baseline: This was a warning, and a declaration. A declaration that we weren’t to avoid this all-or-nothing battle. And we couldn’t refuse it.
hunks.sol: This was both a warning and a declaration: don’t try to avoid the all-or-nothing battle ahead. And we couldn’t refuse.

hunks.baseline: *With Prince Shangshan in their grasp, there’s no way to avoid it, no matter what we do.*
hunks.sol: *With Prince Shangshan in their grasp, there’s no way out of it, no matter what we do.*

hunks.baseline: The fact that our enemies had engineered the situation meant they were confident of victory. But no matter how thorough their preparations or how many traps they’d set, we couldn’t back down.
hunks.sol: Our enemies had engineered this situation because they were confident they’d win. But however thoroughly they’d prepared, whatever traps they’d set, we couldn’t back down.

hunks.baseline: *We have to fight. Right now, before we worry about winning or losing, we have to make a decision.*
hunks.sol: *We have to fight. Before we worry about winning or losing, we have to make that decision.*

hunks.baseline: The enemy had arranged the stage, and they intended to star in it. But sometimes, against everyone’s expectations, the supporting actor outshines the lead.
hunks.sol: Our enemies had built the stage intending to star in the show. But sometimes a supporting actor defies everyone’s expectations and outshines the lead.

hunks.baseline: To change the lead of the coming performance—and the ending of this story.
hunks.sol: To change who took center stage—and how this story ended.

hunks.baseline: And fortunately, there was one important surprise in the imperial palace that the enemy didn’t know about.
hunks.sol: Fortunately, there was one important cameo in the imperial palace that our enemies didn’t know about.

hunks.baseline: The downpour obscured my view, and the sky was already pitch-black. Below the pavilion, Embroidered Uniform Guard soldiers stood watch in shifts.
hunks.sol: The downpour obscured my view, and the sky was already pitch-black. Below the pavilion, members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard stood watch in shifts.

hunks.baseline: There were about twenty of them, all Peak masters.
hunks.sol: There were about twenty of them, every one a Peak master.

hunks.baseline: But even if they were Supreme Peak masters, they couldn’t predict a sudden lightning strike.
hunks.sol: But even Supreme Peak masters couldn’t predict a sudden lightning strike.

hunks.baseline: FLASH! KABOOM!
hunks.sol: Flash! Kaboom!

hunks.baseline: At the instant white light flashed and a thunderous boom rang out, I pushed off the railing and sprang into the air.
hunks.sol: As white light flashed and thunder boomed, I pushed gently off the railing and sprang into the air.

hunks.baseline: The Ghost Illusory Slaughter Step, a signature martial art created by the greatest assassin of all time, unfolded from my feet.
hunks.sol: The Ghost Illusory Slaughter Step, a signature martial art created by the greatest assassin of all time, unfolded beneath my feet.

hunks.baseline: I hadn’t formally learned it; I’d only managed to work a little of it in. But that was enough to slip past the watchers during the brief confusion.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t been taught it formally; I’d only worked a little of it into my movements. But that was enough to slip past the watchers in the brief confusion.

hunks.baseline: I landed on the roof of a pavilion I didn’t know by name, said to house the palace attendants, and shot forward—quietly, but swiftly.
hunks.sol: I landed on the roof of a pavilion whose name I didn’t know, one said to house the palace attendants, and shot forward—quietly but swiftly.

hunks.baseline: With the layout of the imperial palace already etched deep in my mind, I didn’t hesitate for even a moment.
hunks.sol: The layout of the imperial palace was already etched deep in my mind. I didn’t hesitate.

hunks.baseline: The grounds were vast—vast enough to be boundless—with pavilions lined up here and there between them.
hunks.sol: The grounds were vast, with pavilions scattered across them.

hunks.baseline: The black clothes I wore blended into the darkness, and the guards posted throughout the grounds failed to catch my movements.
hunks.sol: My black clothes blended into the darkness, and the guards posted throughout the grounds never caught sight of me.

hunks.baseline: The imperial guards grumbled as they gazed up at the sky from beneath the eaves. They had no idea that an uninvited guest had just passed within two steps behind them and entered the Outer Palace.
hunks.sol: The Imperial Guards grumbled as they looked up at the sky from beneath the eaves. They had no idea an uninvited guest had just passed two steps behind them and entered the Outer Palace.

hunks.baseline: “Y-Yes, sir!”
hunks.sol: “S-sir!”

hunks.baseline: The only ones startled by that rock-hard voice weren’t the soldiers. I was just about to move on when I saw the familiar face that had suddenly appeared and swallowed a groan.
hunks.sol: The Imperial Guards weren’t the only ones startled by that voice, hard as rock. I was about to move on when I saw the familiar face that had suddenly appeared and swallowed a groan.

hunks.baseline: A high-ranking Thousand Captain in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, he was walking toward the soldiers.
hunks.sol: A high-ranking Thousand Captain in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, he was walking toward the Imperial Guards.

hunks.baseline: And at the same time, he was heading toward me, concealed not far away in the darkness.
hunks.sol: And toward me, hidden not far away in the darkness.
